rules: Any segment outside allowed_changed_segments must be byte-for-byte identical to base_snapshot_path.
During prepared edit state, actual changes must be a subset of allowed_changed_segments; after the content patch the guard is immediately restored to exact-set enforcement.
Preamble, day headers and back matter are immutable unless explicitly allowlisted in a future guard.
Safety/consent/mechanics changes require explicit specialist review and a new guard.
Every meaningful edit slice must create a new base snapshot and refresh this guard before further editing.
